newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume surges on jewellery demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume surges on jewellery demand.

text.p: Volume surged on Istanbul's gold exchange on Friday amid demand from the jewellery sector spurred by lower prices in international markets, dealers said.
Traded volume jumped to 1,760 kg from 1,065 on Thursday.
Gold closed at $372.50 an ounce, down $0.50 from Thursday. But in lira terms it rose to 1,224,000 lira per gram from 1,220,600 due to strong demand from the free market.
"Lower ounce prices fuelled demand by jewellery producers," said one dealer. Banks were also active.
There was 810 kg of trade in the morning session and 950 kg in the afternoon. 61 percent of the total was in dollar terms.
